var model = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js"), fmt = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/format-wikitext.js"), fixtures = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/fixtures.js"); describe("outline delete and merge", function() { function build(text) { return model.buildModel($tw.wiki, text); } function idOf(m, s, kind) { var all = m.units.filter(function(u) { return m.text.substring(u.start, u.end) === s && (!kind || u.kind === kind); }); return all[all.length - 1].id; } function del(text, s, mode, kind) { var m = build(text), id = idOf(m, s, kind), r = fmt.deleteUnit(text, m, id, mode); if(r) { expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, id, "deleteUnit", r.text, undefined, r)).withContext(s).toBe(true); } return r; } function merge(text, s, content) { var m = build(text), id = idOf(m, s), r = fmt.merge(text, m, id, content); if(r) { expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, id, "merge", r.text, undefined, r)).withContext(s).toBe(true); } return r; } it("deletes an item with its sub-items", function() { expect(del("* a\n* b\n** b1\n*** b2\n* c", "* b").text).toBe("* a\n* c"); expect(del("* a\n* b\n** b1", "* b").text).toBe("* a"); expect(del("* a\n** a1\n* b", "** a1").text).toBe("* a\n* b"); }); it("an only item takes its list along", function() { var r = del("para\n\n* only\n\nend", "* only", undefined, "item"); expect(r.text).toBe("para\n\nend"); expect(r.removed.length).toBe(2); var m = build("para\n\n* only\n\nend"); expect(fmt.deleteCount(m, idOf(m, "* only", "item"))).toBe(1); }); it("deletes a heading with its section, or only its line", function() { var t = "! A\n\nx\n\n!! B\n\ny\n\n! C\n\nz"; expect(del(t, "! A").text).toBe("! C\n\nz"); expect(del(t, "!! B").text).toBe("! A\n\nx\n\n! C\n\nz"); // Only the heading: its section joins the one above expect(del(t, "!! B", "own").text).toBe("! A\n\nx\n\ny\n\n! C\n\nz"); expect(del(t, "! A", "own").text).toBe("x\n\n!! B\n\ny\n\n! C\n\nz"); var m = build(t); expect(fmt.deleteCount(m, idOf(m, "! A"))).toBe(3); expect(fmt.deleteCount(m, idOf(m, "! A"), "own")).toBe(0); // "own" is for headings only expect(fmt.deleteUnit(t, m, idOf(m, "x"), "own")).toBe(null); }); it("an only child takes its container along", function() { var t = "p\n\n<div>\n\n! H\n\nx\n\n</div>\n\nend"; var r = del(t, "! H"); expect(r.text).toBe("p\n\nend"); var m = build(t); expect(fmt.deleteCount(m, idOf(m, "! H"))).toBe(2); // Only the heading's line: the section keeps the container alive expect(del(t, "! H", "own").text).toBe("p\n\n<div>\n\nx\n\n</div>\n\nend"); }); it("deletes a whole list, a block, the last unit", function() { var t = "p1\n\n* a\n** a1\n* b\n\np2"; var m = build(t), list = m.units.filter(function(u) { return u.kind === "list"; })[0]; var r = fmt.deleteUnit(t, m, list.id); expect(r.text).toBe("p1\n\np2"); expect(r.removed.length).toBe(4); expect(fmt.deleteCount(m, list.id)).toBe(3); expect(del(t, "p1").text).toBe("* a\n** a1\n* b\n\np2"); expect(del(t, "p2").text).toBe("p1\n\n* a\n** a1\n* b"); expect(del("p\n\n```\nc\n```\n", "```\nc\n```").text).toBe("p\n"); }); it("deletes every unit of the corpus with a guarded, plausible result", function() { var n = 0; Object.keys(fixtures.NOTES).forEach(function(k) { var t = fixtures.NOTES[k], m = build(t); m.units.forEach(function(u) { var r = fmt.deleteUnit(t, m, u.id); if(!r) { return; } n++; expect(r.text.length).toBeLessThan(t.length); expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, u.id, "deleteUnit", r.text, undefined, r)).withContext(k + " " + u.id).toBe(true); }); }); expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(20); }); it("the guard refuses a delete that merges neighbours", function() { var t = "* a\n\npara\n\n* b", m = build(t), id = idOf(m, "para"); // Removing the paragraph without a separator would merge the two lists into one expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, id, "deleteUnit", "* a\n* b", undefined, {removed: [id]})).toBe(false); expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, id, "deleteUnit", "* a\n\n* b", undefined, undefined)).toBe(false); }); it("merges an item into the item above", function() { var r = merge("* a\n* b\n* c", "* b"); expect(r.text).toBe("* ab\n* c"); expect(r.caret).toBe(1); expect(r.select).toBe(0); // Into the parent, into the last sub-item of the previous sibling expect(merge("* a\n** b", "** b").text).toBe("* ab"); expect(merge("* a\n** a1\n* b", "* b").text).toBe("* a\n** a1b"); // Its sub-items keep their lines and levels expect(merge("* a\n* b\n** b1\n* c", "* b").text).toBe("* ab\n** b1\n* c"); // Editor text instead of the current content; "" deletes the item; line breaks become <br> expect(merge("* a\n* b\n* c", "* b", "new").text).toBe("* anew\n* c"); expect(merge("* a\n* b\n** b1", "* b", "").text).toBe("* a\n** b1"); expect(merge("# a\n# b", "# b", "x\ny").text).toBe("# ax<br>y"); // The caret goes to the end of the target's editor text expect(merge("* x<br>y\n* b", "* b").caret).toBe(3); }); it("merge needs an item above in the same list", function() { // A blank line between items is still one list: it goes with the merge expect(merge("* a\n\n* b", "* b").text).toBe("* ab"); var t = "* a\n\npara\n\n* b", m = build(t); // Two lists: b is the first item of its own list expect(fmt.mergeTarget(m, idOf(m, "* b"))).toBe(-1); expect(fmt.merge(t, m, idOf(m, "* b"))).toBe(null); m = build("para\n\n* a"); expect(fmt.merge("para\n\n* a", m, idOf(m, "* a", "item"))).toBe(null); m = build("p"); expect(fmt.mergeTarget(m, 0)).toBe(-1); }); it("mergeSource: the item below that merges into an item (Delete at its end)", function() { var t = "* a\n* b\n** b1\n* c\n\npara\n\n* d", m = build(t); expect(fmt.mergeSource(m, idOf(m, "* a"))).toBe(idOf(m, "* b")); // An item with sub-items: its first sub-item expect(fmt.mergeSource(m, idOf(m, "* b"))).toBe(idOf(m, "** b1")); expect(fmt.mergeSource(m, idOf(m, "** b1"))).toBe(idOf(m, "* c")); // The last item of a list: the next list is another one expect(fmt.mergeSource(m, idOf(m, "* c"))).toBe(-1); expect(fmt.mergeSource(m, idOf(m, "* d"))).toBe(-1); expect(fmt.mergeSource(m, idOf(m, "para"))).toBe(-1); }); it("splits an item: the rest goes to a new item right below", function() { function split(text, s, rest) { var m = build(text), id = idOf(m, s), r = fmt.split(text, m, id, rest); if(r) { expect(model.checkOp($tw.wiki, m, id, "split", r.text, undefined, r)).withContext(s).toBe(true); } return r; } var r = split("* ab\n* c", "* ab", "cd"); expect(r.text).toBe("* ab\n* cd\n* c"); expect(r.select).toBe(5); // With sub-items the new item becomes the first sub-item: they stay with the item expect(split("# a\n#* a1\n# b", "# a", "x").text).toBe("# a\n#* x\n#* a1\n# b"); // Line breaks become <br>; nothing to split off: null expect(split("* a", "* a", "x\ny").text).toBe("* a\n* x<br>y"); expect(split("* a", "* a", " ")).toBe(null); var m = build("para"); expect(fmt.split("para", m, 0, "x")).toBe(null); // The inverse of merge var t = "* one\n** a\n* two", s1 = split(t, "* one", "rest"), m1 = build(s1.text); var back = fmt.merge(s1.text, m1, idOf(m1, "** rest")); expect(back.text).toBe("* onerest\n** a\n* two"); }); it("itemBefore finds the item visually above a position", function() { var t = "* a\n** a1\n*** a2\n* b", m = build(t), a = idOf(m, "* a"); expect(m.text.substring(m.units[fmt.itemBefore(m, a, m.units[a].subtreeEnd)].start).indexOf("*** a2")).toBe(0); }); it("a heading or paragraph turned into a bullet joins a list next to it", function() { function conv(text, src, type) { var m = build(text); return fmt.convert(text, m, idOf(m, src), type); } expect(conv("! H\n* a\n* b", "! H", "bulleted").text).toBe("* H\n\n* a\n* b"); expect(conv("! H\n\n* a", "! H", "numbered").text).toBe("# H\n\n* a"); expect(conv("* z\n\npara\n\n* a", "para", "bulleted").text).toBe("* z\n\n* para\n\n* a"); expect(conv("! H\n\npara", "! H", "bulleted").text).toBe("* H\n\npara"); }); }); ","type":"application/javascript","tags":"[[$:/tags/test-spec]]"},"$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/test-edit.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/test-edit.js","text":"/*\ title: $:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/test-edit.js type: application/javascript tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]] Tests for replace, insertNew, editSource and isMultiline in format-wikitext.js. \*/ "use strict"; var model = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/model.js"), fmt = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/format-wikitext.js"), fixtures = require("$:/plugins/rimir/outline/test/fixtures.js"); describe("outline edit", function() { function build(text) { return model.buildModel($tw.wiki, text); } function unit(m, pred) { return m.units.filter(pred)[0]; } function idOf(m, s) { // last match = innermost (a list and its only item can share a source) var all = m.units.filter(function(u) { return m.text.substring(u.start, u.end) === s; }); return all[all.length - 1].id; } it("replace keeps rest", function() { var text = "* a\n** a1\n* b", m = build(text), u = m.units[idOf(m, "* a")], r = fmt.replace(text, m, u.id, "changed"); expect(r.text).toBe("* changed\n** a1\n* b"); expect(r.select).toBe(0); fixtures.assertOnlyRangesChanged(text, r.text, [[u.start, u.end]], expect); }); it("editSource returns own source", function() { var text = "* a\n** a1\n* b", m = build(text); expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"))).toBe("a"); }); it("editor shows and replaces content only: item markers and heading prefixes stay", function() { var text = "! Head\n\n* a\n**# deep\n;term\n:def\n\npara", m = build(text); expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, idOf(m, "! Head"))).toBe("Head"); expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, idOf(m, "**# deep"))).toBe("deep"); expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, idOf(m, ";term"))).toBe("term"); expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, idOf(m, "para"))).toBe("para"); expect(fmt.replace(text, m, idOf(m, "! Head"), "New").text).toBe("! New\n\n* a\n**# deep\n;term\n:def\n\npara"); expect(fmt.replace(text, m, idOf(m, "**# deep"), "x").text).toBe("! Head\n\n* a\n**# x\n;term\n:def\n\npara"); expect(fmt.replace(text, m, idOf(m, ":def"), "d2").text).toBe("! Head\n\n* a\n**# deep\n;term\n:d2\n\npara"); // Content that looks like markup stays content; the own marker typed out of habit is not doubled expect(fmt.replace(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "*bold*").text).toContain("\n* *bold*\n"); expect(fmt.replace(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "* b").text).toContain("\n* b\n"); }); it("code blocks and <<< quotes: the editor leaves out their fence lines, they stay", function() { var text = "```js\nvar a;\nvar b;\n```\n\n<<<.cls\nsaid\n<<< Someone\n\n```\n```", m = build(text), code = idOf(m, "```js\nvar a;\nvar b;\n```"), q = idOf(m, "<<<.cls\nsaid\n<<< Someone"); expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, code)).toBe("var a;\nvar b;"); expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, q)).toBe("said"); expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, idOf(m, "```\n```"))).toBe(""); expect(fmt.replace(text, m, code, "x()").text).toBe("```js\nx()\n```\n\n<<<.cls\nsaid\n<<< Someone\n\n```\n```"); expect(fmt.replace(text, m, q, "one\ntwo").text).toBe("```js\nvar a;\nvar b;\n```\n\n<<<.cls\none\ntwo\n<<< Someone\n\n```\n```"); // CRLF text: the inserted line breaks follow it var crlf = "```\r\na\r\n```", cm = build(crlf); expect(fmt.editSource(crlf, cm, 0)).toBe("a"); expect(fmt.replace(crlf, cm, 0, "b\r\nc").text).toBe("```\r\nb\r\nc\r\n```"); }); it("a whole > quote: the editor shows its lines without their first >, saving puts it back", function() { var text = "para\n\n> q1\n>> deeper\n>* item\n> q2\n\nend", m = build(text), list = unit(m, function(u) { return u.kind === "list"; }).id; expect(fmt.editSource(text, m, list)).toBe("q1\n> deeper\n* item\nq2"); expect(fmt.replace(text, m, list, "q1\n> deeper\n\nnew\n* item").text) .toBe("para\n\n> q1\n>> deeper\n> new\n>* item\n\nend"); // Unchanged: the same source expect(fmt.replace(text, m, list, fmt.editSource(text, m, list)).text).toBe(text); }); it("line breaks in items and headings are stored as <br>, shown as line breaks", function() { var text = "! H"), "H\nsub\n").text).toBe("! H<br>sub\n\n* a\n** a1\n* b\n\npara"); // A new item expect(fmt.insertNew(text, m, idOf(m, "* b"), "n1\nn2").text).toBe("! I"); // A heading: a new heading goes after its whole section, other blocks right after the heading line expect(fmt.insertBlock(text, m, idOf(m, "! H"), "heading1", "G").text).toBe("! H\n\npara\n\n* a\n** a1\n\n! G\n\n! I"); expect(fmt.insertBlock(text, m, idOf(m, "! H"), "bulleted", "first").text).toBe("! H\n\n* first\n\npara\n\n* a\n** a1\n\n! I"), "code", "x\ny"); expect(r.text).toBe(text + "\n\n```\nx\ny\n```"); expect(r.select).toBe(text.length + 2); expect(r.kind).toBe("block"); expect(fmt.insertBlock(text, m, idOf(m, "para"), "numbered", "n1\nn2").text).toContain("\n\n# n1<br>n2\n\n"); expect(fmt.insertBlock(text, m, idOf(m, "para"), "quote", "q").kind).toBe("item"); // Blank content, an item anchor: nothing expect(fmt.insertBlock(text, m, idOf(m, "para"), "paragraph", " ")).toBeNull(); expect(fmt.insertBlock(text, m, idOf(m, "* a"), "paragraph", "x")).toBeNull(); }); }); describe("convert", function() { function conv(text, source, type) { var m = build(text), id = typeof source === "number" ? source : idOf(m, source); return fmt.convert(text, m, id, type); } it("offers the types that fit the unit", function() { var text = "! H\npara", "!
